candidate_workaround: Restrict module-reference searches to scripts and tests, then use importlib spec discovery for the exact module name.
failure_signature: A repository-wide recursive search for the inherited correction module exceeded its bounded timeout and returned no complete search result.
recurrence_guard: Search only relevant source roots and use import-spec inspection; never treat a timed-out broad search as absence evidence.
rollback: Give the timed-out search zero absence or inventory credit and preserve its timeout before the bounded replacement.
scope_boundary: Closeout source-search recovery only; no terminal-pass, scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Bound inherited module searches to relevant source roots
trigger_preconditions: A module-reference search would otherwise traverse the full inherited checkout.
